text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Old Age Pensions and Disability Allowances (Advisory Committee) Rules.

There shall be constituted a committee to be called the Old Age and Disability Pensions Advisory Committee (referred to in these Rules as the Committee) to give advice and assistance to the Controller of Pensions in connection with the discharge of his functions under the Act.
The Committee shall consist of a chairman and not more than eleven other members, to be appointed by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan.

heading.en: Term of office of chairman and members

text.en: The chairman and other members shall hold office for a period which, in the case of each of the members first appointed and of any member appointed to fill any casual vacancy, shall be of such duration not exceeding 3 years as may be determined by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan and in the case of all other members shall be a period of 3 years: Provided that any member may, in writing, resign office at any time and shall be eligible for re-appointment from time to time on or after the expiration of his term of 6 and Disability Allowances

His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan may if he thinks fit appoint by writing under his hand a temporary member to take the place of any member who is temporarily ill or absent from Brunei Darussalam. Vacation of appointments

If a member becomes, in the opinion of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, unfit to continue in office or incapable of performing his duties, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan shall forthwith declare his office to be vacant and shall notify the fact in such manner as he thinks fit, and thereupon the office shall become vacant.
